paite: Singgi sing in halmang thillat maitam abawl a; adunglam tong nga ahi a, availam tong nga ahi a, huan asanlam tong thum ahi. Kiptak a bawl ahi.
heading: Thillatte Halna Maitam Bawlna / (Eks 27.1-8)
english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

paite: Aning lite ah akii abawl a; akiite akibang vek ua; dal in aluan hi.
english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

paite: Atui-um belsuan tengteng, maitam, belte, vutluahte, salu kuangte, sa thuknate leh meibel tengteng dal in abawl hi.
english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

paite: Huan alaizangtak nuai ah among dang ah dal hakvang maitam a ding in abawl hi.
english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

paite: Chiangte omna ding in, dal hakvang mong lite a ding in sikkual li asung hi.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

paite: Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

paite: Azawnna ding in, maitam pang a sikkualte sung ah zawlte athunlut a; maitam singpek in asung ahawmsak hi.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

paite: Dal in tuikuang leh akhe abawl a, numei nasem, kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a kikhawmte' limlangte abawl hi.
heading: Dal Tuikuang Bawlna / (Eks 30.18)
english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huangsung abawl a; simlam pang simlam ah huangsung puankhai, puanmalngat hoih koptah, tong zakhat a-om hi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Huangsung / (Eks 27.9-19)
english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

paite: Akhuamte sawmnih ahi ua, adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; khuam bannate leh adangka puanduangte a-om uhi.
english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

paite: Amallam pang a ding in puankhaite tong zakhat ahi ua, akhuamte uh sawmnih leh adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; akhuamte abannate leh dangka gaknate.
english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

paite: Atumlam pang a ding in tong sawmnga a sau puankhaite a-om ua, akhuamte sawm leh akingakna khuakkuak sawm; akhuamte abannate leh adangka gaknate a-om uhi.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

paite: Asuahlam pang suahlam a ding in tong sawmnga.
english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

paite: Kongpi sik khat a puankhaite tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah.
english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

paite: Hiai lam leh huai lam, huangsung kongpi sik khat lam pang a ding in puankhai tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah ahi.
english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

paite: Huangsung akimvel a puankhai tengteng puanmalngat koptah hoih ahi.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

paite: Khuam kingakna khuakkuakte dal ahi ua; khuam bannate leh adangka gaknate dangka azingte uh luanna; huangsung khuam tengteng dangka in agaknate akibawl hi.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

paite: Huangsung kongpi a puankhai phim a khui, khau dum, khau sandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah ahi. Adunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, apek sanlam tong nga ahi, huangsung puankhaite toh akituak hi.
english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

paite: Akhuamte li ahi a, akingakna khuakkuakte li, dal a bawl ahi. Abannate dangka a bawl, dangka a bawl azingte leh adung luante.
english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

paite: Biakbuk kilhna zum teng leh huangsung kimvel kilhna tengteng dal ahi uh.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

paite: Hiai biakbuk vankim, sim a om bang in, theihpihna biakbuk ate ngei, Levite nasepna dia, Mosi thupiak bang zel a siampu Aaron tapa, Ithamar khut a bawl ahi uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Lamna Sik Vanzatte
english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: Huchi in Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng abawlta hi.
english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Amah toh sem, gelh nasep siam, khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat a zebawl siam, Aholiab, Ahisamak tapa, Dan nam a mi ahi.
english: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

paite: Dangka-eng tengteng mun siangthou a nasepna teng a sepna dia zat, thillat dangka-eng nangawn, talent sawmnih-le-kua leh shekel, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

paite: Dangka, khawmpi a simte mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in talent zakhat leh shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

paite: Michih a ding in beka khat, huai bel, shekel kimkhat ahi, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, michih sim a omte a ding in, kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam, pasal nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga.
english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

paite: Dangka talent zakhat mun siangthou a kingakna khuakkuak a ding in asung ua, puanzak a kingakna khuakkuakte toh; talent zakhat a dia kingakna khuakkuak zakhat, kingakna khuakkuak khat a dia talent khat zel.
english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

paite: Shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga in khuam bannate abawl a, azingte luan in akimatsak hi.
english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

paite: Thillat dal talent sawmsagih leh shekel sangnih-le-zali ahi.
english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

paite: Huaite in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kingakna khuakkuak abawl a, dal maitam leh dal hakvang a bawl, maitam tui-um belsuan tengteng toh.
english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

paite: Huangsung kimvel a kingakna khuakkuak, huangsung kongpi kingakna khuakkuak, biakbuk kilhna zum tengteng leh huangsung kimvel a kilhna zum tengteng azou hi.
english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.
